rule_or_pattern: ^ΣΥΝΕΔΡΙΑΣΗ .*ΦΕΒΡΟΥΑΡΙΟΥ 19\d\d$ (running heads: the numeral koppa 'Ϟ΄' is misread as '7΄', 'Η΄' or '3-'), plus lines flagged C:len_vs_book_high (two-line crops)
notes: This is a 1985 parliament record. The body lines are correct, and the English lines (4-6, 21, 24, 27, 34, 37) are a real English treaty text (EMBL agreement), correctly read, so the other-language flag is genre. The running head 'ΣΥΝΕΔΡΙΑΣΗ Ϟ΄ — 21 ΦΕΒΡΟΥΑΡΙΟΥ 1985' is misread on every page: the koppa becomes '7΄' (22, 33) or 'Η΄' (28), and in 29 '3-21 ... 1935'. Lines 23 and 31 are small-type two-line crops whose labels join both lines.
